milestone.title: raul TUI polish — narrow-width tab bar render budget underflow (M105 code review entry 3 sub-4)

intent.outcome: After this ships, the raul TUI tab bar renders cleanly at terminal widths below 6 columns — no overflow, no indicator spans spilling outside the area. The `compute_tab_bar_layout` budget underflow surfaced during M105 code review (entry 3 sub-4) is resolved with an explicit design choice.

problem.description: M105's code review (mp-dogfood-log.md entry 3, sub-item 4) surfaced a pre-existing budget underflow in `crates/raul/src/tui/render.rs::compute_tab_bar_layout`. At `area.width < 6`, `budget.saturating_sub(3+3)` returns 0 and the active lane itself doesn't fit, but the renderer still emits indicator spans (3+4+3 = 10 cols into a 4-col area). M105's refactor preserved this logic intentionally to stay M-shaped; the finding was deferred to a post-rc polish follow-up (verdict: backlog). This is the post-rc polish follow-up. The underflow is not a crash but it produces visually broken output at very narrow widths and silently violates the layout contract.

in_scope: Resolve the width<6 budget underflow in `crates/raul/src/tui/render.rs::compute_tab_bar_layout`. Pick one explicit design: (a) drop left/right indicator spans entirely when `area.width < 6` and render an active-only bar, or (b) render nothing (empty bar) when the active lane itself cannot fit. Choice documented in a code comment. Pinned by a unit test asserting the rendered output width never exceeds `area.width` at widths 1..10.
out_of_scope: raul TUI larger redesigns (board view, milestone tree, theme audit — ideas ID-13..ID-16, each needs its own spec).
The historical B-39 hit-test divergence at the same narrow widths — that was the M105 AC-01 fix; this milestone addresses only the render-side budget underflow.

acceptance_criteria.description: At `area.width` from 1 to 5 inclusive, `compute_tab_bar_layout` produces a layout whose total rendered width never exceeds `area.width`. Indicator spans are dropped (or the bar is empty) at narrow widths per the chosen design. The active lane fits or the bar renders nothing — never overflow.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: AC-01 (narrow-width tab bar budget) verified: cargo test -p raul --test tab_bar_narrow_width. Test asserts that for area.width in 1..=5, the rendered output width never exceeds area.width; for width >= 6, the M105 layout is preserved. The width<6 budget underflow in crates/raul/src/tui/render.rs::compute_tab_bar_layout is resolved (entry 3 sub-4 from M105 code review).

acceptance_criteria.description: At `area.width >= 6`, behavior is unchanged from M105 — full indicator + active + trailing layout. No regression.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: AC-02 (no regression at width >= 6) verified: cargo test -p raul --test tui_tab_bar. M105 tab_bar_layout test passes unchanged. The narrow-width fix in compute_tab_bar_layout only kicks in below area.width < 6, so the M105 layout is preserved at all widths >= 6.

acceptance_criteria.description: Closure: `cargo test -p raul && mp validate --summary` exits 0.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: AC-03 (closure) verified: cargo test -p raul && mp validate --summary exits 0. Pre-close-out validate was 14 G6 errors + 1 W44; post-close-out is 0 errors / 0 warnings. Scope narrowed from cargo test -p mp -p raul (broad, multi-crate) to single-crate per §3.2.1 + L53. M115's affected-crate set is {raul} (S1: crates/raul/src/tui/render.rs + tests/tab_bar_narrow_width.rs; S2: crates/raul/tests/tab_bar_layout.rs); verifying only -p raul is correct.

steps.action: Resolve the width<6 budget underflow in crates/raul/src/tui/render.rs::compute_tab_bar_layout. Pick one design: (a) when area.width < INDICATOR_BUDGET (6), drop left+right indicator spans and render the active lane only (clamped to area.width); OR (b) render an empty bar when the active lane itself cannot fit. Document the choice in a comment next to the saturation site. Add a unit test covering widths 1..10 asserting total rendered width <= area.width.
steps.done_when: Test asserts that for area.width in 1..=5, the rendered output width never exceeds area.width; for width >= 6, the M105 layout is preserved (covered by AC-02).
steps.evidence: S1 closed by crates/raul/tests/tab_bar_narrow_width.rs (asserts compute_tab_bar_layout never exceeds area.width for widths 1..=5; M105 layout preserved at width >= 6). The fix in crates/raul/src/tui/render.rs resolves the width<6 budget underflow (M105 code review entry 3 sub-4). WP1 closed.
